name: work
description: work — general-purpose work across the fleet, not just code. `/work:loop` is the unattended multi-project drain: spreads load with agents teams + balanced accounts, uses browser/computer/secrets for non-coding, drives each item to landed, merging engineering PRs on green behind a non-author review. `/work:dispatch` is ONE unit of work (coding or not) routed to the right executor. `/work:triage` is the board-wide keep/cancel decision sweep (was top-level `/triage`). Kind-agnostic layer above `code:loop`.
